_comment: Authoritative PDB-author-numbering -> UniProt-canonical-numbering map for the epistaeon benchmark structures. VERIFIED by global pairwise alignment with zero sequence mismatches (scripts/numbering.py, 2026-09-17). ALWAYS apply: uniprot_position = pdb_author_position + offset_to_uniprot. Alignment/tensor site indices are UniProt-canonical; PDB coordinates are NOT. For the non-human structures (1MBO, 1U19), 'human_equivalent' gives the offset from HUMAN UniProt numbering, which is what TOGA2 hg38 residue positions use.

2HHB.reason: initiator Met cleaved in the mature globin

1MBO.reason: initiator Met cleaved in the mature myoglobin

human_equivalent.toga2_check: MB alignment row HLphyCat2 (Physeter macrocephalus) has no indels relative to hg38
human_equivalent.note: Same numbering scheme as human myoglobin. human (and TOGA2 hg38) residue n = 1MBO author residue n-1. Verified by scripts/numbering.py.

1U19.reason: 1:1; but an ACE acetyl cap occupies author position 0 and must be skipped when iterating residues

human_equivalent.toga2_check: RHO alignment rows HLbosTau10 and bosTau9 (Bos taurus) have no indels relative to hg38
human_equivalent.note: Same numbering scheme as human rhodopsin. human (and TOGA2 hg38) residue n = 1U19 author residue n. Verified by scripts/numbering.py.

A.note: Full-length NR3C1 numbering. White-paper residues are AncCR numbering: add 531 (Tyr27->558, Leu29->560, Thr36->567, Ser106->637, Leu111->642). Chain B is a PGC1a coactivator peptide, not GR.
local LBD numbering, not UniProt. Anc + 531 = human GR. N-terminal positions -2/-1/0 are expression-tag residues.
